claim: The MS International Federation Atlas of MS is an external public resource for MS epidemiology and global access-to-care statistics and downloadable country-level datasets.
future_grounding_route: Specific Atlas data tables can be downloaded, hashed, and analyzed separately if a future iteration needs country-level epidemiology or access-to-care grounding.
project_use: Global epidemiology, diagnosis, DMT access, and healthcare-resource context for public readers.
resource_name: MS International Federation Atlas of MS
unique_knowledge_lacks_in_repo: Global MS epidemiology and health-system/resource availability data not held as rerunnable project data.
why_unverifiable: The Atlas aggregates externally collected country-level data and MSIF curation that this repository cannot independently rerun without separate dataset acquisition.
